regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and concentrated: only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and the rotation radar shows a narrow, non-directional structure (frac 0.24, absorption 0.44, one_narrative false). The dominant theme, Banks (H + HK), leads on score but is crowded, mean-revert tagged, and unscorable, so this state reads as a defensive/high-ground market with no predictive edge from the detector itself.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (H + HK) — currently the rotation leader but mean-revert tagged and crowded at 1.07 — loses its eligibility gate OR Energy (H-shares) overtakes it as rotation leader with a durability_bar holding above 0.7. The observable condition that would retire this watch: Banks' crowding_z falls below 0.5 AND its hurst_tag flips from mean-revert to trend/mixed, while Energy's score fails to close the current 0.325 margin within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the highest-scoring eligible theme that is not crowded (crowding_z 0.41, crowded false) and carries the strongest trend-health tag in the top ranks (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.75 — the highest of any eligible theme). It is the challenger to Banks in the rotation structure. I lean positive on the grounds that it is the one eligible, non-crowded, trend-confirmed theme; however, it is unscorable (no proxy ETF), which caps my conviction.
evidence: crowded false, crowding_z 0.41 (not extended relative to leader Banks at 1.07)
challenger in rotation with margin 0.325 to leader
theses.dissent: H-shares Energy is a narrow, policy-sensitive slice of the HK market; its trend tag may simply reflect low volatility rather than genuine momentum, and the mean-revert tag on the overall market leader (Banks) suggests the whole complex is prone to reversal, which could drag Energy with it.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) falls below its durability_bar level of 0.75 or loses eligible-trend status before 30 trading days elapse

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is the second-highest eligible theme that is neither crowded nor mean-revert tagged, with a solid breadth of 0.75 and durability_bar 0.7. It offers a defensive, income-oriented tilt consistent with the narrow, non-directional regime where only four themes qualify. Its mixed hurst tag and unscorable status limit conviction.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed (not mean-revert like the leader)
theses.dissent: Dividend blue chips are essentially a low-beta cash proxy in HK; they tend to lag when any risk-on rotation resumes, and their score of 1.175 is already well below the leader, so this may just be the 'least bad' eligible option rather than a genuine opportunity.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips falls below durability_bar 0.7 or drops out of the eligible set before the 20-day check-by

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks leads the momentum rank and rotation leader board, but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.07, crowded true), mean-revert tagged (hurst_tag mean-revert), and unscorable. Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — so I express this as an avoid rather than underweight. The mean-revert tag specifically undermines staying power even though the absolute-trend gate validates the theme's eligibility.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.625, eligible true, but crowded true
rotation leader with one_narrative false (no single dominant narrative)
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge, and Banks passes it — mean-revert tags can be wrong, and the crowding flag only down-sizes, it does not imply a bail. Avoiding the market leader risks missing the one theme the discipline actually endorses as eligible.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) sustains above its durability_bar 0.62 with crowding_z falling below 0.5 while remaining eligible at the 20-day check-by

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
